author: omar

page.title: Hifth — revise on the page you memorised

quote.exact:
The page you know
        The 604-page mus'haf, line for line, so a verse sits where your memory puts it.
      
      
        Look-alike verses, one tap apart
        Verses that are easy to mix up are linked, so you can jump between them and see what differs.
      
      
        Mark where you slipped
        Put a mark on the word you stumbled on, and see where your mistakes gather over time.

body: I want a features section, "Mark Your Mistakes" (mistake marking CX), "Drop Notes" (Notes view / notes page) , "Share With Your Teacher", "Review Your Progress" (calendar view)  all with different features of the app. Also Reflect on each verse (study quran, etc)
